Studio portrait of the woman from the reference image wearing a plain emerald green (#1F6B4F) ribbed knit turtleneck against a seamless warm cream (#F3EBDD) backdrop with gold, ivory and deep red glass baubles each hanging on its own long thin ribbon that runs straight down from the ceiling, every ribbon continuing all the way up out of the top edge of the frame (no short ribbons floating in mid-air). Clean soft light from the front-right. Head-and-shoulders, hands out of frame. Shot on Sony A7 IV, FE 85mm f/1.8, f/2.8, 1/200s, ISO 100. Keep the face exactly as in the reference photo: the same facial features, face shape and skin, nothing altered and no added makeup; real skin texture. Realism: this must look like a real photograph taken in a real small photo studio, not a CGI render — only light natural retouching, visible skin texture and pores, fine flyaway hairs, slight natural asymmetry in the face and expression, realistic fabric wrinkles; not doll-like, not plastic, not perfectly symmetrical. Body proportions: small head with a realistic adult Korean model head-to-body ratio of about 1:8 (head height about one eighth of total height), slim neck and normal shoulder width; never a big head, never chibi or bobblehead proportions, and the head must not look oversized relative to the shoulders and torso. She is the only person in the frame. There are no signs, posters, brand logos or lettering anywhere in the frame; no props other than what is described; modest clothing. Anatomically correct human body: exactly two arms, two legs, two hands with five fingers each, natural joints and proportions; no extra, missing, duplicated, or merged limbs, and no duplicated or cloned faces.
